mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic regime.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declined over the prior month, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate (UNRATE) increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals labor market deterioration, triggering immediate equity sell-offs due to reduced consumer spending and corporate profit expectations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE rises >0.3pp, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) indicate robust consumer demand expansion, driving corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days through joint demand-side momentum.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS increase, or interaction term Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, industrial production (INDPRO) growth decelerating below 1.0% year-over-year signals weakening economic momentum, causing equity market corrections through reduced corporate capacity utilization and earnings visibility.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO growth <1.0% yoy during late-cycle expansion, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 1.5% signals robust economic activity and corporate capacity utilization, driving immediate equity market gains through elevated earnings expectations over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO increases >1.5% qoq, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 2-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 2.5% indicates accelerating inflation, triggering central bank tightening expectations that increase real interest rates and depress equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL >2.5%, or Rank IC remains negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in monthly payroll growth (PAYEMS) and increases in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signal labor market contraction, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through joint labor market deterioration.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS growth declines and UNRATE rises, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In post-recession recovery regimes, quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) exceeding 2.0% signals strong economic rebound, boosting corporate earnings and consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days through demand-side momentum.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 growth >2.0% qoq during post-recession recovery, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 2-year rolling windows.
